items.label: of 2024 big-concert crowds came from another city (festivals 62.2%)

footnote: Source: CAPA and Dengta Pro (Apr 2025, Dengta platform data)
notes: Where they come from. In 2024, 64.2% of large-concert audiences travelled from another city, and 62.2% of festival audiences. By the tier of the host city, shows in Tier 1 cities still draw 46.5% local fans, while in Tier 4 cities locals are only 18.6% and 48.5% come from elsewhere in the province. The smaller the city, the more outsiders. The cities with the highest share of travelling concert fans were Xianyang at 93.4%, Yantai at 88.7% and Changzhou at 87.9%. Reports of the 2025 figures, 64.6% for concerts and 68.4% for festivals, disagree on whether they count other cities or other provinces, so we use the checked 2024 numbers. For us it means fans take the train, check into a hotel and eat out, so stations, hotels, late-night food and the city itself are all touchpoints. The image is an AI-generated illustration.
